entries.candidate: Iron Mountain AZP-3 data center building and data-hall fit-out (5100 E Roosevelt St, Phoenix, AZ): under_construction admission as of 2026-09-23 (removed in verification)
entries.reason: Removed by verifier worker 2. The only in-window physical observations are City of Phoenix permit completions (finals) on 23 September 2026 of the building's sprinkler and fire-alarm/VESDA installations and of SC33/SC37 sprinkler modifications; open permits (new building 24010806, SC31/SC33/SC35/SC37 TI) are not physical observations. The fragment's later-status review did not consider that operator disclosure, so 'under_construction' for the data-center building conflicts with the operator's own status and is not established.
